description: Ground-truth labels for deliberate negative and anomaly scenarios in the manufacturing traceability dataset.

edge_cases.description: Defect references a material lot that does not exist.
edge_cases.expected_decision: Traceability validation must flag the broken material-lot reference.

edge_cases.description: A material required by the BOM is not recorded as consumed for the production order.
edge_cases.expected_decision: Material reconciliation must flag the missing consumption.

edge_cases.description: A corrective action is marked closed before verification is completed.
edge_cases.expected_decision: CAPA lifecycle validation must reject or flag the premature closure.

edge_cases.description: The defect quantity exceeds the quantity inspected.
edge_cases.expected_decision: Inspection/defect arithmetic validation must flag the inconsistent quantity.

edge_cases.description: A deliberate break is introduced in the traceability chain.
edge_cases.expected_decision: End-to-end traceability validation must identify the broken relationship.
